## Why

Split out of S198 on 2026-10-30 (owner, interactive): S198 accepts v11, updates the prompts and records the gate verdict; the engine rules below have no failing test there and slicer does not enforce them.

Rules to check against the engine and implement where it differs (confirm each against `slicer ai relay` and `slicer ai relay-orchestrator` on v11):

- A small fix round is checked and gated in one pass by the read-only role that raised its findings.
- A clean merge of main is regated by the one-pass small-fix check on the merge diff.
- A Check line marked [AFTER LAND] is deferred to Land step 6.
- A non-blocker owner question is asked in the ledger as it arises (`relay-run ask` without `--blocker`, step stays running) and read with `relay-run answer --get` before the finish step; ork's `internal/slicercli/write.go:308` always asks with `--blocker`.
- `relay-run list` `counts.roles` counts lane steps only (ork reads `Counts` at `internal/slicercli/types.go:179`).

Needs a spec round (files, failing tests, owner decisions) before it is ready.
